structuredContent.content:
with:
          python-version: "3.13"
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: uv.lock
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: "1.4.4"
      - run: uv sync --locked --all-extras
      - name: Scan Python dependencies
        run: uv run --with pip-audit pip-audit --format json > pip-audit.json
        continue-on-error: true
      - name: Scan frontend dependencies
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun audit --json > ../bun-audit.json
        continue-on-error: true
      - name: Check tracked content for likely secrets
        run: python agent-hooks/check_staged_changes.py --tracked
      - name: Upload dependency scan results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dependency-audit-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            pip-audit.json
